class QuestionApplication
  ask(question: ApplicationQuestion) -> QuestionObservation
  observe(request_key: str, wait_ms: int) -> QuestionObservation
class QuestionApplicationClient(QuestionApplication)
  __init__(transport)
  ask(question: ApplicationQuestion) -> QuestionObservation
  observe(request_key: str, wait_ms: int) -> QuestionObservation
dataclass QuestionObservation

  answer: Answer | None
class QuestionOperator
  list_questions(cursor: str, limit: int) -> OperatorPage
  answer_question(id: str, option: str) -> OperatorDecision
  retire_question(id: str) -> OperatorRetirement

  answer_question(id: str, option: str) -> OperatorDecision
  retire_question(id: str) -> OperatorRetirement
